title: Per-User Usage
description: Which registered account used how much of which provider/model. Backed directly by Postgres (inference_logs joined to users) rather than Prometheus, since per-user labels on scraped metrics would be unbounded cardinality. Scoped to registered accounts only — pre-auth anonymous sessions have no user row and are intentionally excluded.

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT email FROM users ORDER BY email

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM users
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM inference_logs il JOIN users u ON u.id = il.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(il.timestamp)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(il.total_tokens),0) AS value FROM inference_logs il JOIN users u ON u.id = il.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(il.timestamp)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT il.user_id) AS value FROM inference_logs il JOIN users u ON u.id = il.user_id WHERE $__timeFilter(il.timestamp)

panels.title: Usage by User
panels.description: Every registered account, including ones with zero requests in the selected range. Ignores the User picker above so the full roster is always visible.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  u.email AS "User",
  COUNT(il.*) AS "Requests",
  COALESCE(SUM(il.total_tokens), 0) AS "Total Tokens",
  COALESCE(SUM(il.prompt_tokens), 0) AS "Prompt Tokens",
  COALESCE(SUM(il.completion_tokens), 0) AS "Completion Tokens",
  ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(il.latency_ms), 0)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Latency (ms)",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE il.status <> 'success') / NULLIF(COUNT(il.*), 0), 1) AS "Error Rate (%)",
  COUNT(DISTINCT il.provider) AS "Providers Used",
  MAX(il.timestamp) AS "Last Active"
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN inference_logs il
  ON il.user_id = u.id AND $__timeFilter(il.timestamp)
GROUP BY u.email
ORDER BY "Requests" DESC

panels.title: Provider / Model Breakdown (selected user)
panels.description: Filtered by the User picker above — pick one or more accounts to see exactly which provider and model they used.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  u.email AS "User",
  il.provider AS "Provider",
  il.model AS "Model",
  COUNT(*) AS "Requests",
  COALESCE(SUM(il.total_tokens), 0) AS "Total Tokens",
  ROUND(AVG(il.latency_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "Avg Latency (ms)",
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE il.status <> 'success') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "Error Rate (%)"
FROM inference_logs il
JOIN users u ON u.id = il.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(il.timestamp)
  AND u.email IN (${user:sqlstring})
GROUP BY u.email, il.provider, il.model
ORDER BY "Requests" DESC
